name: wow-forever
description: Offline WoW Forever guide for Hermes, for any race, class and faction (Spanish UI, English optional): trainers, spells and class quests, leveling zones, professions with a leveling plan, dungeons with bosses and loot, a curated Horde Hunter guide checked against the data, Legacy, and a local market fed by Auctionator, TSM accounting and the WoWForeverBridge daily diary. Includes a skill that answers from the same data with a read-only script. No network. Reads only Auctionator.lua, TradeSkillMaster.lua and WoWForeverBridge.lua inside the folder the user grants.
